description: This file defines multiple verifiable credential reasoners using the AgentRouter from '@agentfield/sdk'. It includes four main reasoners demonstrating different patterns: basic VC generation, AI analysis with VC audit trail, data transformation with integrity proof, and multi-step chained VCs. Each reasoner specifies input/output schemas, processing logic, and VC creation steps.

methods.name: reasoner
methods.description: Defines a reasoning pattern with input/output schemas, processing logic, and VC generation for each pattern.
